note: ONE INSTANCE, NOT A LAYOUT. Bar position, zone widths and marker speed vary per chest and appear to depend on the opener's 陷阱解除 value. Do not read these numbers as constants; the policy must parse every chest.

marker.motion: bounces at each end, ~700 and ~1210; it does not wrap

attempt.model: tap when the marker will be at targetX after inputLatency; target = centre of the reachable zone

variability.zoneWidths: random per chest, suspected to scale with 陷阱解除
variability.markerSpeed: varies per chest, slow to fast
variability.validConstant: input latency 48.7-67.2 ms (the agent's own pipeline)
